purpose: This table holds every NYC-area (JFK, LGA, EWR) flight departure reported for January through June 2013 by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics, cleaned from the bronze nycflights13 flights capture, for downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analysis.
usage: Consumers should treat actual_departure_time, departure_delay_minutes, actual_arrival_time, arrival_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes as nullable and branch on nulls deliberately: a null in these columns means the flight never departed or never arrived, not a missing-data error. Join on carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport_code, and the year, month, day columns to identify a single scheduled flight instance, and use tail_number only when non-null for aircraft-level analysis.
limitations: Per operator convention this table should carry one calendar DATE column instead of three integer parts (year, month, day), but the cleanup proposal schema allows only one action per bronze column, so the three remain separate pending a dedicated date-construction step; roughly 3% of rows (null_rate 0.029388 to 0.032981) lack departure or arrival times, delays, and air time because those flights never departed or arrived, and 0.9% of rows (null_rate 0.009154) lack a tail number, none of which is imputed.
